name: quality-gate
description: Self-contained Claude Code plugin: the Quality Gate dispatcher + per-language gates (Rust, Go, Python, Node.js, Java, Swift, Kotlin, Web) + the `quality-gate` skill. Fails only when a PR worsens a metric vs a chosen base ref; tamper-resistant rulesets; absolute (no-base) mode; ships an opt-in pre-push hook that blocks push/PR-create on a failing gate.
